title: A full proposal for the cleaning of six offices, with the options placed, a quote, a picture and an appendix
person: The bid manager of a facilities company with forty cleaners, writing the full proposal after walking the customer's offices.
review: The saving of GBP 56,000 a year, the six offices' costs, the three options with their savings and the 95% audit target are in the deck; the matrix highlights the quadrant where one contract sits and the title names it; the quote is one sentence with its speaker's role; the audit report is shown whole with a caption and a source; the floor-area table and what the price covers stand behind the closing page, numbered A1 and A2.
revised_review: The decision date is 9 December 2026 on every page that mentions it; 4 December appears nowhere.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
Every content page is titled with its message, as a sentence.
One message and one exhibit a page.
From eight pages on the deck opens with the answer and shows its storyline.
The deck closes on actions with an owner and a date each.
Every chart and table names its source.
No placeholder or filler text.
Every chart names its measure, unit and period.
Charts are labelled on their marks, horizontally.
Bars start at zero; no 3D; no crowded pie.
A chart shows more than the figures beside it.
At most one highlight a chart or table, on what the title names.
Tables are as tall as their rows, numbers right-aligned, one precision a column.
All text fits its box.
Every content page fills the body inside the preset's bounds.
Every content page carries a number of words inside the preset's bounds.
Nothing under the preset's smallest size; one title size.
Text and chart marks have the contrast WCAG 2.2 asks for.
The title and the running line sit at one position, on one baseline.
Slide titles, reading order, alternative text, language and file name are in place.
The matrix names its axes and quadrants and highlights what its title says.
The figure is one picture at its own proportions, with a caption, a source and alternative text.
The quote is one sentence with who said it and their role, and nothing else.
Backup pages stand behind the closing page in the appendix's own count.

source: Synthetic material created for this library; the companies, people, figures and addresses are invented.
stage_policy: Separate first and revision directories; reveal revision only after first output is frozen.
